title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN- September 20th - Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, delivered a speech at parliament’s public plenary session,
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN- September 20th - Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, delivered a speech at parliament’s public plenary session, "

"Source: Iran's Parliament "

"========="

"SOT1, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:39): "We believe that the dichotomy between war and negotiation is not real; rather, one must both fight and negotiate. One must fight rationally and powerfully, and at the appropriate time, negotiate with authority and rationality. This means that at the necessary moment, we must use all our military capabilities to push the enemy back and deal fatal blows; however, once significant battlefield victories have been achieved and the enemy is weakened, we must use the tools of diplomacy to consolidate these advantages.""

"SOT2, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament (Farsi)-(00:40 - 01:17): "Our messages and conditions have been explicitly conveyed to the opposing side through intermediaries, and the enemy knows well that the path of deception and unilateral imposition is closed. Until these conditions are met—namely, that the legitimate rights of the Iranian nation are recognized and American commitments are implemented—there will be no opening for a return to previous negotiation terms or the opening of the Strait of Hormuz.""

"SOT3, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament (Farsi)-(01:18 - 01:56): "Today, the old American order in West Asia has collapsed, and it is the Islamic countries of the region that must establish a new order. Relying on the historical will of the nation, the wisdom of brave commanders on the ground, and hope in the generation currently in school classrooms, seminaries, and universities, we will show that the path to the future will be shaped not by pleading, but by rationality, courage, and struggle.
